reason: In authz/client/src/main/java/org/keycloak/authorization/client/util/crypto/AuthzClientCryptoProvider.java:103-110, concatenatedRSToASN1DER() copies len = signLength / 2 bytes twice from signature via System.arraycopy() without checking signature.length == signLength. A malformed shorter signature therefore throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException instead of the declared IOException, though callers such as core/src/main/java/org/keycloak/crypto/ECDSASignatureVerifierContext.java:25-32 catch Exception.
